cases.stimulus: Power/reset release with jar absent, then assert a speed
cases.expected: Hardware gate remains off; no start; IL visible when running firmware can report.

cases.stimulus: Remove jar during an established run
cases.expected: Q and final enable drop within 1 ms; firmware PB0/PWM requests clear within 10 ms; inertia continues.

cases.stimulus: Reseat with speed latch still down
cases.expected: Q remains zero; no motor restart until qualified STOP, release and new command.

cases.stimulus: Hold PULSE through withdrawal and replacement
cases.expected: No held-through restart; release and a new command are required.

cases.stimulus: Open and reclose before the next firmware poll
cases.expected: Latch retains lost permission; a bare AND gate is not sufficient.
Every opening clears Q; only final continuous 20 ms closure can qualify rearming.

cases.stimulus: Break the loop wire while the jar is in place
cases.expected: Raw JAR_OK is low; no qualified permission.

cases.stimulus: Hold STOP while reseating, then wait beyond 20 ms
cases.expected: Q must remain zero until a subsequent new STOP assertion.

cases.stimulus: Reset or brownout with jar mechanically seated
cases.expected: Q disarms; physical jar/latches/heat/momentum are not erased.

cases.stimulus: Open while core halted or interrupts masked
cases.expected: Hardware latch/gate must still clear without firmware execution; CPU recovery is a separate test.

cases.stimulus: Warm motor reaches TH after IL shutdown
cases.expected: Retain appropriate causes; no fake ST from coastdown; apply declared priority.

cases.stimulus: Weld/bypass contact or force raw node high with jar absent
cases.expected: Record unobservable single-channel fault; do NOT assert guaranteed detection or safe permission.

cases.stimulus: Fresh STOP after closure qualifies while old speed remains latched
cases.expected: STOP releases speed and blocks physical RUN_PERMIT; Q setting alone cannot energize drive.

cases.stimulus: Contact opens at the same instant as a rearm request
cases.expected: Clear must dominate set; no single-step enabling pulse.
